title: origanum vulgare subsp. viride
intro: Origanum vulgare subsp. viride, commonly known as Green Oregano, is a subspecies of the Oregano plant, belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region, valued for its numerous health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Green Oregano include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and exhibit antiseptic and antiviral effects. The bioactive constituents of Green Oregano include carvacrol, thymol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
